Create ONE new full-body standing/ready static pose of Albino Tantalus Tunnel Vermin. This is an original systemic project variant, not a canon-exact claim.

Composition: exactly ONE subject, fully visible, head/front facing RIGHT, slightly elevated side/three-quarter 2D-game view, neutral alert stance. All appendages, tail tips and feet included. Background: genuinely transparent RGBA. No backdrop, scenery, cast shadow blob or checkerboard painted into pixels.
